items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is Lemma 11.3.36 at source lines 1341-1343: if u is close to y_delta within epsilon then u is close to the limit of y within epsilon + delta. The author's proof (source lines 1344-1355) is a genuine induction on the Cauchy reals whose limit case needs three separate ingredients: the inductive hypothesis is first specialised by taking y := x and delta := eta to obtain a family of closeness statements about lim(x) (lines 1347-1348), then roundedness is used to shave the parameter and the triangle inequality to combine the two closenesses (lines 1350-1352), and the fourth constructor of the relation is applied before an arithmetic choice of eta := theta/4 closes the estimate (lines 1353-1354). The statement records none of the auxiliary closeness or of the choice of eta.
